definitions: Past participle of withdraw: to pull back or remove.
Past participle of withdraw: to take money out of an account.
Past participle of withdraw: to retract a statement or offer.
Past participle of withdraw: to remove oneself from a situation or group.
examples: The troops were withdrawn from the region.
Funds have been withdrawn from the account.
The proposal was withdrawn after public outcry.
She had withdrawn from social activities.
